transform_convention: matrix4x4 is row-major; multiply homogeneous column vectors; divide xyz by w; child world=parent@local. raw_transform13 is skppy native, NOT Ruby column-major16.
limitations: Independent parser; compare dimensions and render against source before fabrication.
Target is in its definition-local frame; outer pantry placements excluded.
Hidden/tag visibility filtering is not applied; parser may not expose all face/instance visibility.
Textures, UVs, attributes, curves, guides, annotations and design constraints are not exported. Polygon boundaries and edge flags are retained.
A geometry-bearing definition is an occurrence, not automatically a confirmed manufacturing part.
Extraction is not a SolidCraft import or a fabrication release.
